options.title: Write a short PRD before the next line of code
options.body: Before writing any code, define the problem, target user, and core features with acceptance criteria. Note what's explicitly out of scope and any technical constraints. Produce the actual spec artifact — the document itself, with these sections named. A written PRD now prevents scope drift and rework later.

options.title: Write a short PRD first
options.body: Write a short PRD: problem, target user, core features, and what's out of scope. Doesn't need to be long — just written down before more code gets built.

options.title: Write the problem down first
options.body: Write down the problem, who it's for, and what's out of scope. Now, before more code.
